author: Monica Bremer
text: Rowland Septic Service was Great.  After another company "no showed" for septic clean out I called Rowland based on neighbor recommendation and they were communicative, timely (although a bit early), proper respectful of property and really nice.  Would recommend to any neighbor.

author: James Garner
text: Al and his team delivered. Called scheduled a time and date and they delivered. Showed up on time as scheduled got the job done Highly satisfied with their services and recommend them for all your environmental needs. Will definitely use them for our future needs.

author: Matthew Smith
text: Al and his team really helped me out in a pinch, on a holiday weekend, to put in a new septic pump and clean out of the main tank so that a cancer patient could have a safe space to return to after a lengthy hospitalization at UNC Cancer Hospital. Al did a septic inspection and pump prior to closing on this house five years ago, and he was great then too. I will continue to use them and recommend to anyone who asks in the future! The service and prices are fair and top-notch. Thanks again!

author: Brandon Murray
text: Al and his tech Daniel helped us in a last minute pinch today. Did a great job repairing a broken pipe in our septic system. Will definitely be using them for all of our future septic servicing !

author: Catina Bethea
text: This company promptly rushed out to do an emergency service call for maintenance and repair on a septic issue. Mr. Rowland and his co-worker Daniel were both super polite and knowledgeable about the problem. He even took the time to explain the issue. I learned they not only do cleaning, maintenance and repair, but they also do inspections. I will use this company over and over again. I have already referred someone else.  You can expect honestly and a job well done!
